title: 第二十一章龙爪爆头第二十一章龙爪爆头
content_zh:
;;
感受着四周所散去的能量之威。
龙战盯着秦风，神情凝重道：“你居然将神龙真元给吸收了？？”
“不可能！爹！他体内都没有我们龙家血脉，如何能吸收神龙真元？是不是您感知错了？？”
在其身后的龙云沁发疯般的叫道。
然而，另外几位龙家长老们的脸上神情，都很难看，似乎察觉到了秦风此刻的不同寻常。
“既然是我自己得到的东西，将其吸收有问题吗？”
“至于你，龙云沁！！在这件事之气，我可一直将你当妹妹看待，没想到，你比我想象中的还要恶毒！！龙野爷爷没少指点你吧？你是如何做到这般狠心焚尸的？？”
秦风怒视着龙云沁道。
“恶毒？这也算恶毒吗？要不是这老东西，你早就死在龙家了！！”
“别说是焚尸，就算鞭尸一万次，都算是便宜这老东西。”
“秦风！！你胆敢！！”
“行了，闭嘴吧。”
不等龙云沁把话说完，龙战怒喝制止。
“爹！我....”
“嗯？”
龙云沁明显不服气，可感受到自己老爹身上所散发出来的怒火之威后，只好乖乖闭上嘴巴。
“秦风，你可知道你这样做，会承担怎样的后果？”
“那可是我们秦家的未来！！”
“你居然.....”

其中一位长老指着秦风道。
“杂种！！是不是你杀害了老夫之孙？”
大长老用凶狠恶煞的神情盯着秦风问道。
“没错，是我干的。”
“都是我杀的。”
“我还不止要杀他们，还有你们这群老家伙，也都得死！！”
秦风毫不畏惧道，即便他已经落入了包围圈，但像是反包围了众多龙家强者一样。
“哈哈哈哈！”
“小子，我看你是脑子出问题了吧？也不看看你现在的处境。”
“居然还好意思狗叫？”
“只要族长大人一声令下，你立马便会被挫骨扬灰！！”
“懂吗？”
龙家二长老笑道。
其余几位长老也都用看傻子的目光盯着秦风，似乎想不明白，这家伙是哪里来的勇气，敢说出那番话。
秦风没有理会二长老的嘲讽，而是直视龙战道：“神龙真元，就在我体内。”
“想要，就来拿！！”
见秦风居然敢主动挑衅自己，龙战神情不动，但却心中呢喃道：“这小子，到底哪里来的胆量？难不成，他没有吸收神龙真元，而是将这股能量赠送给了凶鸟王？不可能吧....就算是凶鸟王，也无法完全吸收掉神龙真元的能量。”
“莫非，是更厉害的凶兽？”
“到底是谁，敢与我龙家为敌呢？”
“可恶！！”

“小子，别废话！本长老这就先废了你！！”
“杀！！”
话音落下，报仇心切的大长老赫然不顾龙战之命令，朝着秦风率先发难。
恐怖的通天境圆满之威爆发，让周围的那些龙城修士们，都有种窒息感。
只见大长老右拳轰出，狮虎之威肆虐，化为一股可怕劲气轰击秦风。
content_en:
;;
Feel the power of energy dissipating around you.
Long Zhan stared at Qin Feng and said solemnly: "You actually absorbed the dragon's true essence??"
"Impossible! Dad! He doesn't have the blood of our Long family in his body, how can he absorb the dragon's true energy? Did you perceive it wrong??"
Long Yunqin behind him shouted like crazy.
However, the expressions on the faces of the other Long family elders were ugly, and they seemed to have noticed that Qin Feng was unusual at this moment.
"Since I got it myself, is there any problem with absorbing it?"
"As for you, Long Yunqin!! After this incident, I have always treated you as my sister. Unexpectedly, you are more vicious than I imagined!! Grandpa Long Ye gave you some advice, right? How did you do it so cruelly and burn the corpse?"
Qin Feng glared at Long Yunqin and said.
"Vicious? Is this considered vicious? If it weren't for this old guy, you would have died in the Long Family!!"
"Let alone burning the corpse, even if the corpse is whipped ten thousand times, it will still be considered a bargain for this old thing."
"Qin Feng!! How dare you!!"
"Okay, shut up."
Before Long Yunqin could finish speaking, Long Zhan shouted angrily to stop him.
"Dad! I..."
"Huh?"
Long Yunqin was obviously unconvinced, but after feeling the power of anger emanating from his father, he had no choice but to keep his mouth shut.
"Qin Feng, do you know what consequences you will bear if you do this?"
"That is the future of our Qin family!!"
"You actually..."
One of the elders pointed at Qin Fengdao.
"Bastard!! Did you kill my grandson?"
The great elder stared at Qin Feng with a fierce expression and asked.
"Yes, I did it."
"I killed them all."
"Not only do I want to kill them, but you old guys also have to die too!!"
Qin Feng said without fear, even though he had fallen into the encirclement, it was as if he had been surrounded by many powerful people from the Long family.
"Hahahaha!"
"Boy, I think there's something wrong with your brain, right? I don't even look at your current situation."
"You actually have the nerve to bark?"
"As long as the patriarch gives the order, you will be crushed to ashes immediately!!"
"Understand?"
The second elder of the Long family smiled.
The other elders also stared at Qin Feng like a fool, as if they couldn't figure out where this guy got the courage to say those words.
Qin Feng ignored the second elder's ridicule, but looked directly at Long Zhan and said: "The true essence of the dragon is in my body."
“If you want it, come and get it!!”
Seeing that Qin Feng actually dared to provoke him, Long Zhan remained calm, but he murmured in his heart: "Where did this kid get the courage? Could it be that instead of absorbing Shenlong's true essence, he gave this energy to the Ferocious Bird King? Impossible... Even the Ferocious Bird King cannot completely absorb the energy of Shenlong's true essence."
"Could it be a more powerful beast?"
"Who dares to be the enemy of our Long family?"
"Damn it!!"
"Boy, stop talking nonsense! This elder will destroy you first!!"
"Kill!!"
After the words fell, the vengeful elder suddenly ignored Long Zhan's order and took the lead in attacking Qin Feng.
The terrifying explosion of perfect power in the Heaven-reaching Realm made the surrounding Dragon City monks feel suffocated.
I saw the great elder punching out with his right fist, and the power of the liger was raging, turning into a terrifying force to bombard Qin Feng.
